metadata.description: Strix Open — the SGRF v1 governance-review skills. Review how any system governs execution, score it on four orthogonal axes, and wire a first governed action. Advisory; no Strix account required.

plugins.name: strix-governance
plugins.description: Run a Strix Governance Review (SGRF v1) on a system (/strix-governance:runtime-governance-review), a PR (/strix-governance:govern-pr), or a release (/strix-governance:release-readiness); wire a first governed, recorded action (/strix-governance:strix-wire, one read-only analysis authorization + separate wrap and execution approvals); and onboard a new client organization end-to-end (/strix-governance:strix-onboard — tenant, systems, capabilities, policies, credentials, connectivity, one governed smoke test, then independent proof verification). Plugin skills are namespaced /strix-governance:<skill>. The three review lenses are advisory and run anywhere; strix-wire runs with zero account (Sandbox or Offline Mode).
